## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Camp Verde, United States. It starts at 3505 W. SR-260 Camp Verde.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Nestled in the Mingus Mountains, Out of Africa Wildlife Park is your Stateside Serengeti, a 103-acre reserve that's home to some of the world's most wondrous animal life.
>
> The park strives to both educate and entertain. As well as marveling at the residents – giraffes, rhinos, black bears, leopards, caimans, zebras, and the like – you can catch expertly led displays and feeds to get a real understanding of the animals' nature.
>
> With a mixture of vehicular and on-foot experiences, you'll really feel like you're on safari!

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €48.46. It was rated 4.7 out of 5 from 36 ratings and 22 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
